quarterly_data.quarter: STMicroelectronics press release: STMicroelectronics introduces automotive image sensor to (09-14-2026)
quarterly_data.signal: Product launch: ST SafeSense VD56GA, a 1.1 MP automotive infrared image sensor for driver and occupant monitoring, with 35% higher MTF sharpness and nearly 60% higher quantum efficiency than the previous generation, in a 3.7 mm x 3.2 mm CSP package; front-end manufacturing at ST's Crolles, France facility with packaging in Asia. Samples are available now. The release also says ST announced earlier this year the shipment of its 10 millionth SafeSense automotive image sensor.
quarterly_data.figure: 1.1 MP; 35% higher sharpness, nearly 60% higher quantum efficiency vs previous generation; samples available now
